# Desi Merge: Android Launcher Icon

## Artwork (original, generated by `LauncherIconBuilder`)

| Layer | File | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Background | `Assets/_Project/Art/Icon/LauncherBackground.png` (432 × 432) | Magenta radial gradient, saffron sunburst rays, a saffron ring with navy and teal truck-art dots |
| Foreground | `Assets/_Project/Art/Icon/LauncherForeground.png` (432 × 432, transparent) | The game's smiling mango, a small nimbu merging into it, a white sparkle |

- **No text**, and the silhouette is strong (the large mango), so it is readable at small sizes.
- It uses the same mango as the splash, so the branding is consistent.
- All art is drawn by project code from the game's own item art; nothing is copied.
- Preview as launchers mask it (circle and rounded square): `Documentation/Screenshots/launcher-icon-preview.png`.
- **Safe zone:** launchers show the centre 72 dp of the 108 dp layers and may mask any shape. All foreground pixels sit inside the 66 dp safe circle, so nothing important is cropped. This is checked by the test `LauncherIcon_ForegroundArtStaysInsideTheSafeZone`.

## Unity configuration

- **Player Settings → Android → Icon → Adaptive:** every density slot has background = `LauncherBackground`, foreground = `LauncherForeground`. Checked by the test `LauncherIcon_AndroidAdaptiveIcon_HasBothOriginalLayers`.
- **Legacy and round slots:** Unity 6000.6 marks them obsolete for Android (using them is a compile error), and minSdk 26 means every supported phone uses the adaptive icon. `Art/AppIcon.png` stays the default icon for other platforms.
- **Regenerate:** **Desi Merge > Setup > Regenerate Launcher Icon** (overwrites the two PNGs and re-applies them).

## Name and identity

- **Label under the icon:** "**Desi Merge**", set by the build step `AndroidAppLabel`, which edits the generated `strings.xml`. The Unity product name stays "DesiMerge" on purpose, because changing it would move the Editor/Windows save folder.
- **Application ID:** unchanged, `com.DefaultCompany.DesiMerge` (placeholder company; choose your permanent ID before the first Play upload).
- **Splash:** the same mango, magenta and saffron branding (Bootstrap scene).

On-device appearance is **not verified** (no phone was connected). See `Phase66_UI_Enhancement_Report.md` for the APK check.
